focus: Enterprise Features: Granular Permissions (26), Auto Surcharging, Live Sales, Hardware Integrations, Automated Reports, Products Enhanced Fields
summary: Tested all iteration 12 enterprise features. All 31 backend tests pass. All frontend features working correctly with proper RBAC enforcement. Custom permissions system working - cashier sidebar filtered based on owner-set permissions.

TestAuth.test_owner_login: PASS - Returns user with role=owner and JWT token

TestPermissions.test_get_staff_permissions_owner: PASS - Owner can get staff permissions
TestPermissions.test_set_staff_permissions_owner: PASS - Owner can set custom permissions

TestSurcharging.test_get_surcharge_settings: PASS - Returns config with enabled, weekendSurcharge, publicHolidaySurcharge
TestSurcharging.test_save_surcharge_settings_owner: PASS - Owner can save surcharge settings
TestSurcharging.test_check_surcharge: PASS - Returns current surcharge percent and reason

TestLiveSales.test_live_sales_owner: PASS - Returns totalSales, transactionCount, avgTicket, byHour, recentTransactions
TestLiveSales.test_live_sales_manager: PASS - Manager can access live sales

TestReports.test_generate_itemised_report: PASS - Returns items with name, qty, revenue, profit, margin
TestReports.test_generate_detailed_report: PASS - Returns full P&L with revenue, expenses, grossProfit, netProfit

TestUpsells.test_get_upsells: PASS - Returns upsell suggestions based on cart items

TestReportConfig.test_get_report_config_owner: PASS - Owner can get automated report config
TestReportConfig.test_save_report_config_owner: PASS - Owner can save report config

frontend.Settings_Permissions_tab: PASS - Staff selector, 26 checkboxes, Select All/Clear All/Save buttons
frontend.Settings_Surcharges_tab: PASS - Enable toggle, weekend %, holiday %, day selection, holiday dates, save button
frontend.Settings_Hardware_tab: PASS - Add Printer button, Add Scanner button, lists display
frontend.Settings_Receipt_tab: PASS - Logo URL, Payment/Social/Promo QR toggles, save button
frontend.Products_dialog: PASS - Locations field, Online Channels (Website/Uber Eats/DoorDash/Menulog/Deliveroo/Google Food), SEO description, Description
frontend.Cashier_custom_permissions: PASS - Sidebar shows only 4 items (Dashboard, POS, Products, Customers) based on custom permissions
frontend.Manager_restricted_access: PASS - Permissions and Surcharges content hidden from manager

critical_code_review_comments: All 26 granular permissions properly implemented covering all sidebar items
Custom permissions override role-based defaults in Sidebar.jsx
Surcharge settings stored in settings collection with key 'surcharge_config'
Hardware integrations (printers/scanners) stored in separate collections
Products enhanced with locations, onlineChannels, seoDescription, description fields
RBAC properly enforced - owner-only features hidden from manager/cashier
seed_data_creation: Test printers and scanners created during testing (prefixed with TEST_) - cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 tested enterprise features: 26 granular permissions, auto surcharging (weekend/holiday), live sales reporting, hardware integrations (printers/scanners), automated reports (itemised/category/detailed), products enhanced with locations/onlineChannels/seoDescription. Custom permissions system works: owner sets via POST /api/permissions/staff/{id}, /auth/me returns customPermissions, Sidebar.jsx filters nav items. Cashier currently has custom permissions ['pos','customers','products','dashboard']. All features working. Auth token stored in localStorage as 'nuva_token'. API base URL: https://pos-checkout-16.preview.emergentagent.com
